implementation_summary: Removed helperSessionKey (HKDF of RUNNER_ACCESS_TOKEN). Each HelperAccess now signs qa_helper cookies with randomBytes(32) made in its constructor (newHelperSessionKey), held in memory only; optional sessionKey option is a test seam (>=32 bytes). Claims are {email, sub, exp}: signHelperSession(key, {email, sub}, now, seconds) throws without sub; readHelperSessionValue refuses missing/empty/non-string/>128-char sub; the MAC covers sub. Sign-in route passes the verified Firebase {email, sub}. Grants still looked up by email. HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Secure on https, 8 h cap, timingSafeEqual, refusal wording and ERR codes unchanged. HTTP reply bodies unchanged.
